_about: Production spec for vehicle/turn_signal and vehicle/turn_signal_off (the 'dash' candidate, chosen by ear 2026-09-29). Render with the genny CLI (github.com/ogomez92/genny): genny render sound-test/turn_signal.json, then encode each WAV to Ogg Vorbis (ffmpeg -c:a libvorbis -q:a 6). The blinker is ONE flasher cycle, tick then tock 0.45 s apart, 0.7 s long: longer than the 0.45 s lane-change cadence and shorter than the 0.9 s blinker beat, so play_if_idle restarts it on every beat and the rhythm never stumbles. The off-click is the stalk snapping back to centre.
